critical.description: Number of workloads that have 1 or more critically risky services as its highest risk

high.description: Number of workloads that have 1 or more high risk services as its highest risk

medium.description: Number of workloads that have 1 or more medium risk services as its highest risk

low.description: Number of workloads that have 1 or more low risk services as its highest risk

fully_protected.description: Number of workloads that have no risky services and are fully protected
